_note: en = English voiceover (TTS-only; the brand is spelled 'Hojent X' so the voice reads it as ho-jent-X). zh = Chinese subtitle groups, no trailing punctuation. zh_onscreen = groups whose text is already the on-screen headline, so no subtitle bar is shown. hold_s = silence held after the segment before the next one.

segments.en: Every hotel runs on one formula. Available rooms, times occupancy, times rate. Minus channel cost. Minus labour.
zh: 每一家酒店都靠同一个公式运转
可售房晚 × 入住率 × 房价
减去渠道成本，减去人力

segments.en: And every day, a little of it leaks away. Empty rooms nobody saw coming. Prices set wrong. A low rate left online overnight. A bad review that costs the next booking.
zh: 每一天，收入都在悄悄流失
没提前看到的空房，定错的价格
挂了一夜的低价，赶走下一位客人的差评

segments.en: Not because managers don't care. Because no one can watch five separate systems, every hour, every day.
zh: 而是没有人能每小时盯住五个后台

segments.en: We know. We run twenty-nine hotels ourselves.
zh: 我们知道，因为我们自己也经营着 29 家酒店

segments.en: Back to that formula. Which of these variables is nobody watching?
zh: 这些变量里，哪一个没人管？

segments.en: Hojent X. Digital employees that understand the hotel business.
zh: HogentX，懂经营的酒店数字员工
